source.recovery: Existing public GitHub API receipt; decoded base64 content outside repository. No source body redistributed.

dataset.role: Registered v2 identity only; no dataset body or metadata roster recovered in this component.

mechanics: Four original panels: WT WTC11 and WT Patient Line, manual features and aggregated Plexus observations.
Legacy NumPy seed zero resets independently for each panel; sorted unique locations and guides.
NTC well draw precedes guide draws; class-balancing draws advance the same random stream.
First training split alone is balanced; reciprocal evaluation uses that balanced subset.
NTC guides are positive tasks too, with own guide rows excluded from negatives by literal source substring rule.
Two AUROC values per eligible guide retained; no invented whole-screen aggregation.
implementation_scope: Executable metadata split reconstruction and original-unit prediction scorer; generated controls only.
qualification: Not scientifically qualified; source cohort, paper equivalence, baseline and exposure/inference gates remain unresolved.
